title: Grab And Move should work with TouchScreen & Stylus
author: JimR-15
summary: The report asks Grab and Move to support touchscreen and stylus input, which is a new input-modality feature request rather than evidence that the existing mouse interaction regressed.

status.label: Feature request, not current bug
status.detail: Touch and pen support require an explicit product and interaction design decision.

next_action.label: Clarify feature classification
next_action.reason: Route the request as an enhancement without treating unsupported input as a regression.

judgment.rationale: The requested behavior expands Grab and Move to additional input modalities. The report does not describe a previously supported touchscreen or stylus path that stopped working.
evidence: The title and report request touchscreen and stylus support.
No prior working version or regression boundary is supplied.
No assignee or linked implementation exists.
judgment.recommended_action: Reclassify and evaluate as a feature request, including gesture conflicts and pen/touch interaction design.

issue_context.summary: Grab and Move currently lacks the touch and stylus interaction requested by the reporter.
known_information: The requested input devices are touchscreen and stylus.
The report does not identify a version in which those devices previously worked.
inferences: Adding touch and pen support would require defining gestures, pointer capture, scrolling conflicts, and accessibility behavior rather than repairing a demonstrated regression.
issue_context.analysis: The report is clear enough to classify without diagnostics. Treating it as a feature request preserves the product-design question and avoids asking the reporter to prove unsupported behavior as a bug.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue, labels, assignees, and timeline.
No regression evidence, duplicate, or linked implementation is present.

actions.label: Post feature-request guidance

comment.body: Thanks for the suggestion. Touchscreen and stylus support would add new input modalities to Grab and Move rather than fix a demonstrated regression in its current mouse interaction. This should be evaluated as a feature request, including the intended touch/pen gesture, interaction with normal scrolling and selection, and any accessibility requirements.

actions.note: Draft only; no upstream comment is posted without explicit approval.
